body_html:
Last week I got to celebrate the wedding of my brother Perez (aka RZA aka Gonzo) real name Carmelo. We snuck down to the Philly area and met his beautiful new wife Eboni and her two wonderful children.

Perez is one of the best people I have ever met in the world. I am known to be hyperbolic but this is truth of the capital T. The do not come better than Perez. I am lucky to have such a wonderful brother.

As Peres said in his vows, "I don't feel nice come in last, I feel like I won the whole damn race."

The pastor was a amazing. His words inspiring and hilarious. Beats a Catholic priest anyday.

Bobby, my other brother and the Maid of Honor made it too hard to compete in the department of cool.

Flores, here is the proof. Did not last five minutes.

WWe weren't this bored. Promise, hope the photographer got something better., but its hard when 50% of the subject is me. 

I had such fun with Mica, my little TMNT. Can't wait for my kids to meet their new cousins. Micah is Danny's age. Things will get crazy.

 

All the groomsman, Bobby the best man, Chris, Perez's brother, Kamran a friend from college, me, and then Flores

They had a wonderful wooden bouquet and wooden flower theme. It was so cool.

Mimi and Papa John with bride and groom

What is a wedding without some pre-game.
